entities.name: PMID:25445155
observations: Primary study in WHO class I meningioma cells: photon irradiation increased migration (p<0.02); carbon-ion irradiation did not affect migration or measured integrin expression.
Photon irradiation increased αvβ1 expression by 14% (p=0.0057); blocking αvβ1 or αvβ5 inhibited serum- and photon-induced migration. The authors identify αvβ1 signaling as an important mechanism.

entities.name: Integrin αvβ1
observations: In primary WHO class I meningioma cells, photon irradiation increased αvβ1 expression and αvβ1 antibody blockade inhibited photon-induced migration; carbon-ion irradiation left its measured expression unaffected.
